title: 第8章  跟班主任交往！三年抱俩？
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
林毅顿时一愣，疑惑问道：“刘老师，啥意思啊？怎么突然这么说？”
刘老师看着他一脸懵懂的样子，耐心解释道：“林毅，我不骗你，你这孩子脑子灵光、悟性高，学东西比谁都快，当年你在我班上成绩稳稳前十，好好学绝对是考重点大学的料子。”
“但今时不同往日了，这一晃六年过去，高中教材早就大改了一轮，知识点、考点、题型全部更新，和你当年学的完全不一样。”
“再者说，你今年都二十四了。”刘老师语重心长，“早就过了十七八岁的年纪，现在让你坐回教室，和一群刚高中毕业的小孩同台竞争、熬夜刷题、比拼专注力，你根本跟不上。”
“听我的，别白费力气了。”
他教书这么多年，什么样的学生都教过，比林毅年纪大的复读生都见过。
要知道，随着人年龄的增长，新陈代谢的速度也是一年不如一年，年纪大的复读生就是没有优势。
再加上这几年的高考形势，竞争格外严峻，像林毅这样的复读生……希望可以说是渺茫。
林毅闻言，眼神坚定道：“刘老师，我知道难度大，但我这次是真心想复读、真心想考大学。”
“能不能考上先不说，起码得把当年的遗憾补上，了却自己一桩心愿，不留遗憾。”
刘老师沉默良久，终究是叹了口气：“行吧，你既然铁了心要坚持，我也不多劝了。”
“年轻人有执念是好事，走，我带你去教务处办手续。”
说完，刘老师起身，带着林毅走出办公室，一路直奔教务处。
流程办得很顺利，凭着刘老师的面子和林毅当年的学籍底子，没用多久，复读入学手续就全部办妥。
拿着手里崭新的复读入学证明，林毅心里松了一大口气，眼底闪过一抹亮色。
成了！距离自己重返军营、再次入伍的目标，又稳稳迈进了一大步！
接下来只要一心复读，好好考试，以他的学习能力，考上个本科还是绰绰有余的！
他转头看向身旁的刘老师：“刘老师，那以后就多多麻烦您指教了，我荒废六年没碰书本，刚开始复读进度肯定跟不上，还得靠您多提点。”
刘老师摆手道：“你跟我说这个干嘛？”
林毅疑惑问道：“您不是一直负责带复读班吗？以后我就在您班上了啊？”

刘老师摇了摇头，笑着纠正：“早就不归我管了，我这两年调整了岗位，不带复读班了。”
林毅微微一怔：“啊？那复读班现在是谁带？”
刘老师微微沉吟：“是今年刚毕业新来的女老师，年纪不大，姓李……李……哎呀我这记性，想起来了，叫李舒婉！”
话音落下的瞬间，林毅猛地一激灵。
他脸上的笑容当即凝固，大脑当场宕机，一片空白。
卧槽？？？
不会这么巧吧！！！
教务处办公室内。
刘老师带着林毅走进来，径直看向办公桌前坐着的清冷女人，笑着开口介绍：“小李老师，给你介绍一下，这就是今年分到你复读班的新生。”
说完，他转头看向身旁的林毅：“林毅，这位就是你接下来一年的班主任，李舒婉老师，以后你的学习、作息、班级事务，都归李老师管。”
林毅尴尬的看着李舒婉，李舒婉满眼错愕的看着林毅。
两人四目相对，都看到了对方眼神中的情绪。
刘老师像是没察觉到气氛一般，又看向李舒婉：“李老师，这学生叫林毅，之前在咱们学校读过书，后来入伍当兵去了，退伍回来打算复读，重新参加高考，底子不错，就是荒废了几年学业，你多费心照看一下。”
说着话，他看着林毅的表情，还有李舒婉的眼神。
在学校混了这么多年，他也是人精一个，一眼就看出了不对劲。
两人这眼神，哪里是初见师生的陌生，分明是旧识，还带着点说不清道不明的感觉……
刘老师看破不说破，立马笑着打圆场：“我那边还有点备课工作要处理，就不陪你们聊了，你们师生俩好好对接一下后续的入学事宜。”
话音落下，刘老师不给两人反驳的机会，转身快步离开办公室。
办公室只剩下林毅与李舒婉两人。
林毅嘴角一抽，离谱！太离谱了！

昨天刚相亲完、光速和平散场，今天直接师生见面。
还真是巧了啊……
但要不要这么巧啊！
良久，林毅率先打破尴尬：“那个……李老师，好巧啊，又见面了。”
对面的李舒婉闻言，红唇微勾，勾起一抹淡淡的笑。
只是这笑容不达眼底，清冷的眉眼间藏着一丝若有若无的幽怨和戾气：“是啊，真的好巧，又见面了，林先生。”
“林先生”三个字咬字清晰，满满的阴阳感，听得林毅心头一紧。
不是？这女人怎么还带怨气的？
我也没惹到她啊。
李舒婉身子微微前倾，收起了脸上的浅笑：“林先生，我先跟你明确一件事。”
“昨天的相亲，是我拒绝了你。”
林毅微微挑眉，一脸坦然：“啊，我知道啊，没错，全程都是你拒绝的我。”
他确实没搞懂这女人的脑回路，确实是她拒绝的啊，没必要特地重申一遍吧？
看着林毅一脸理所当然、毫无波澜的样子，李舒婉心头那点莫名的憋屈更甚，像是一拳打在了棉花上，有力无处使。
李舒婉盯着他看了许久：“你是故意的？”
因为家里的缘故，她相亲过不少男的，但像林毅这样的还是头一次见。
其他人要么在听自己说不想相亲时，都只会想尽一切办法靠近自己，自觉他们一定配得上自己。
可越是这样，她就越会反感，而林毅三番两次的拒绝自己。
很难不让她以为，林毅是故意的。
“什么故意的？”林毅疑惑的看着她：“李老师，我还有事，要先走了。”

他现在只觉得这个女人有病，他可不想跟这种女人三年抱俩，他还要回部队呢！
刚转身，他就听到身后传来李舒婉的声音：“等等。”
林毅站定脚步，转头看着她：“李老师，你还有事情吗？”
李舒婉长舒一口气，莞尔一笑：“林毅，你成功了，我发现你确实跟其他的男人不同，我们交往吧。”
林毅：？？？
content_en:
Lin Yi was stunned and asked in confusion: "Teacher Liu, what do you mean? Why did you say that suddenly?"
Teacher Liu looked at his confused look and patiently explained: "Jin Yi, I'm not going to lie to you. You are a kid with a bright mind and a high understanding. You can learn things faster than anyone else. You were in the top ten in my class back then. If you study hard, you will definitely be admitted to key universities."
"But things are different now. Six years have passed and the high school textbooks have been greatly revised. The knowledge points, test points, and question types have all been updated. They are completely different from what you learned back then."
"Besides, you are already twenty-four this year." Teacher Liu said earnestly, "You have already passed the age of seventeen or eighteen, and now you are asked to sit back in the classroom, compete with a group of kids who have just graduated from high school, stay up late to study questions, and compete for concentration. You simply can't keep up."
"Listen to me, don't waste your efforts."
He has been teaching for so many years and has taught all kinds of students, including repeat students who are older than Lin Yi.
You know, as people age, their metabolic rate becomes slower year by year, so older repeat students have no advantage.
Coupled with the college entrance examination situation in recent years, the competition is extremely severe. Repeaters like Lin Yi... have little hope.
When Lin Yi heard this, his eyes were firm and he said: "Teacher Liu, I know it's difficult, but I really want to repeat my studies this time and really want to get into college."
"I don't care whether I can pass the exam or not. At least I have to make up for the regrets of the past and fulfill my wish without leaving any regrets."
Teacher Liu was silent for a long time, and finally sighed: "Okay, since you are determined to persist, I won't persuade you any more."
"It's a good thing for young people to have obsessions. Come on, I'll take you to the Academic Affairs Office to complete the procedures."
After saying that, Teacher Liu stood up, took Lin Yi out of the office, and went straight to the Academic Affairs Office.
The process went smoothly. With Teacher Liu's reputation and Lin Yi's academic record, it didn't take long for all the registration procedures to be repeated.
Holding the brand-new admission certificate for repeat studies in his hand, Lin Yi breathed a sigh of relief, with a flash of light in his eyes.
Done! He is one step closer to his goal of returning to the military camp and re-enlisting in the army!
Next, as long as he concentrates on repeating his studies and takes the exam well, with his learning ability, it will be more than enough to get into a bachelor's degree!
He turned to look at Teacher Liu next to him: "Teacher Liu, I will trouble you for your advice from now on. I haven't touched books for six years. I will definitely not be able to keep up with my rereading progress at the beginning. I have to rely on you to give me more guidance."
Teacher Liu waved his hand and said, "Why are you telling me this?"
Lin Yi asked in confusion: "Aren't you always responsible for leading the repetition class? I will be in your class from now on?"
Teacher Liu shook his head and corrected with a smile: "It is no longer under my control a long time ago. I have adjusted my position in the past two years and no longer teach repeat classes."
Lin Yi was slightly startled: "Huh? Who is leading the repeat class now?"
Teacher Liu pondered slightly: "She is a new female teacher who just graduated this year. She is not very old, and her surname is Li... Li... Oops, my memory reminds me, her name is Li Shuwan!"
The moment the words fell, Ji Yi suddenly became excited.
The smile on his face froze immediately, and his brain shut down and went blank.
Damn it? ? ?
It can't be such a coincidence! ! !
In the Academic Affairs Office.
Teacher Liu walked in with Lin Yi, looked directly at the cold woman sitting at the desk, smiled and introduced: "Mr. Xiao Li, let me introduce to you, this is the new student assigned to your repeat class this year."
After speaking, he turned to look at Ji Yi beside him: "Jin Yi, this is your class teacher for the next year, Teacher Li Shuwan. From now on, your study, work and rest, and class affairs will all be under the control of Teacher Li."
Ji Yi looked at Li Shuwan awkwardly, and Li Shuwan looked at Ji Yi with astonishment.
The two looked at each other and saw the emotions in each other's eyes.
Teacher Liu seemed not to notice the atmosphere and looked at Li Shuwan again: "Mr. LiTeacher, this student’s name is Lin Yi. He studied in our school before, and later joined the army. After being discharged from the army, he plans to repeat his studies and retake the college entrance examination. He has a good foundation, but he has wasted his studies for several years. Please take care of him more. "
As he spoke, he looked at Ji Yi's expression and Li Shuwan's eyes.
After spending so many years in school, he was also a smart person, and he could tell something was wrong at a glance.
The look in the two people's eyes did not reflect the unfamiliarity of meeting teachers and students for the first time. They were clearly old acquaintances, and there was also an inexplicable feeling...
Teacher Liu didn't tell the truth, so he immediately smoothed things over with a smile: "I still have some lesson preparation work to deal with, so I won't talk to you anymore. You two, teachers and students, will discuss the follow-up enrollment matters. "
After the words fell, Teacher Liu turned around and left the office quickly without giving the two a chance to refute.
Only Lin Yi and Li Shuwan were left in the office.
Ji Yi's mouth twitched, outrageous! That's outrageous!
The blind date just ended yesterday and ended peacefully at the speed of light. Today, teachers and students will meet directly.
What a coincidence...
But what a coincidence!
After a long time, Ji Yi took the lead to break the embarrassment: "Um...Teacher Li, what a coincidence, we meet again. "
Li Shuwan opposite heard this, her red lips curled up into a faint smile.
It's just that the smile didn't reach his eyes, and there was a hint of resentment and hostility hidden in his cold eyebrows: "Yes, what a coincidence, we meet again, Mr. Lin. "
The three words "Mr. Lin" were spelled clearly and filled with a sense of yin and yang, which made Lin Yi's heart tighten.
No? Why is this woman still angry?
I didn't offend her either.
Li Shuwan leaned forward slightly and put away the smile on her face: "Mr. Lin, let me make one thing clear to you first. "
"I rejected you on yesterday's blind date. "
Ji Yi raised his eyebrows slightly and said calmly: "Ah, I know, yes, you rejected me the whole time. "
He really didn't understand this woman's brain circuit. It was indeed her rejection. There was no need to reiterate it, right?
Seeing Ji Yi's normal and unruffled look, Li Shuwan felt even more inexplicably aggrieved, as if she had been punched on cotton, unable to exert any force.
Li Shuwan stared at him for a long time: "Did you do it on purpose? "
Because of her family, she had been on blind dates with many men, but this was the first time she had met someone like Ji Yi.
When other people hear that they don't want to go on a blind date, they will only try their best to get close to them, thinking that they must be worthy of them.
But the more this happens, the more disgusted she will be, and Ji Yi rejects herself again and again.
It was difficult not to let her think that Ji Yi did it on purpose.
"What's intentional? Lin Yi looked at her doubtfully: "Teacher Li, I have something else to do and I have to leave first." "
Now he only thinks that this woman is sick. He doesn't want to stay with such a woman for three years, and he has to go back to the army!
As soon as he turned around, he heard Li Shuwan's voice coming from behind him: "Wait a minute. "
Ji Yi stood still and turned to look at her: "Teacher Li, do you have anything else to do? "
Li Shuwan breathed a sigh of relief and smiled: "Jin Yi, you succeeded. I found that you are indeed different from other men. Let's date. "
Lin Yi:? ? ?
